articles.topic: Census 2027 Field Support Officer recruitment, pay and workload
articles.distinct_thesis: The same-day nationwide recruitment is translated into an implied minimum gross hourly comparison, application-pressure ratio and practical assessment of a locally based evening-and-weekend workload covering 450 to 850 homes.

claim_checks.claim: Applications opened for 3,850 roles, with an eight-week contract from 5 April to 28 May 2027, 18 hours weekly and pay above €3,000 plus an allowance.
claim_checks.basis: Current official Census 2027 recruitment and role pages fetched on 23 November 2026.

claim_checks.claim: The campaign closes at 2pm on 4 December or earlier at 12,000 applications.
claim_checks.basis: Current official Census 2027 homepage and role page.

claim_checks.claim: The stated schedule totals 144 hours and €3,000 divided by 144 is €20.83; 12,000 applications divided by 3,850 roles is 3.12.
claim_checks.basis: 18 × 8 = 144; 3,000 ÷ 144 = 20.8333; 12,000 ÷ 3,850 = 3.1169. Both are labelled illustrations, not contract rates or selection odds.

articles.topic: Circuit Court family-law forms and financial disclosure effective 23 November 2026
articles.distinct_thesis: The effective-date change is converted into a practical, financially focused filing guide that separates form acceptance, disclosure content, online Statements of Truth, paper affidavits and unchanged court fees without attempting personalised legal advice.

claim_checks.claim: Only the new forms are accepted from 23 November and the change applies in every Circuit.
claim_checks.basis: Courts Service forms guide and FAQ current on 23 November 2026.

claim_checks.claim: Form 37A covers income, assets, debts, expenditure, liabilities, dependent-family circumstances and relevant pension information.
claim_checks.basis: Courts Service Order 59 rules 42 and 43 and current Form 37A page.

claim_checks.claim: Online or hard-copy filing remains available and the forms change does not change family-law court fees.
claim_checks.basis: Courts Service FAQ; paper swearing and online Statement of Truth distinctions checked against the current divorce guide.

articles.topic: Compulsory poultry housing order effective 23 November 2026
articles.distinct_thesis: The order's first day is turned into a household-scale compliance guide separating confinement, registration, biosecurity and disease reporting, while refusing to invent a universal setup cost.

claim_checks.claim: The compulsory housing order takes effect on 23 November and covers poultry and captive birds beyond commercial farms.
claim_checks.basis: Current Department of Agriculture National Disease Control Centre update.

claim_checks.claim: Poultry premises must be registered even for one or two backyard birds.
claim_checks.basis: Department of Agriculture Poultry Register page and NDCC update.

claim_checks.claim: No HPAI outbreak had been detected in poultry in the Republic during 2026 at the update date; the Co Tyrone flock and Co Derry wild-bird detections showed circulation on the island.
claim_checks.basis: NDCC Disease Update No. 5 dated 17 November 2026; time scope stated explicitly.
